messages:
Sierra (Partnerships): Quick sync — we need final allocations for the QBR partner playbook + credit matrix by EOD Wednesday. Main split: cloud marketplace, HW partners, SI integrations, joint announcement runway. Draft live: https://redwood.work/partners/qbr-playbook (please add comments).

Omar Patel: On it. Do we have target bands by partner tier or is this purely channel-based?

Sierra (Partnerships): Both. Want a matrix mapping tier -> primary channel % + contingency. Example idea: Platinum favors co-funded announcements + reserved marketplace credits; Silver skews toward marketplace credits and SI enablement.

Jin W: Draft percentages I put in the doc, but pasting quick snippet for clarity:

```
# proposed split by channel (example)
Platinum: marketplace 30%, hw 25%, SI 30%, announcements 15%
Gold: marketplace 45%, hw 15%, SI 25%, announcements 15%
Silver: marketplace 60%, hw 5%,  SI 25%, announcements 10%
Contingency pool: 10% (across tiers)
```

Marta Lopez: Can we formalize a 10% contingency across the whole MDF line (not per-tier)? Means we hold a central buffer for deal protection / discounts.

Sam (Finance): 10% contingency is ok but need sign-off thresholds. Anything > $50k draw from contingency requires finance + partnerships lead approval. Also: total MDF cap for this QBR cycle = $1.2M.

Omar Patel: Noted. I'll take marketplace allocation and vendor-side SLAs. Quick Q: do we want marketplace credits timeboxed (90 days) or evergreen? Short bursts reduce misuse.

Sierra (Partnerships): Timeboxed to 90 days for co-markets. For platform-led pilots we can extend to 180 with product sign-off.

Jin W: I'll own the HW partner splits and the gating rubric (POC success metrics). Draft gating snippet in doc: minimum integration test + 1 joint case study or 3 pilot customers -> unlock higher tier credits.

Marta Lopez: For joint announcements — keep 20% of announcements budget reserved for strategic co-announce with top 5 partners (global reach). Others will fall under standard PR support.

Sam (Finance): Put that 20% number into the budget excel and mark as restricted. I will not release until legal confirms announcement SLAs.

partners-bot: Reminder: QBR deck deadline Thu 09:00 UTC — please attach final partner credit matrix to the deck.

Omar Patel: I'll update the deck and the marketplace tab by Tue EOD. @Sierra, can you confirm the top 5 partners list for announcement reservations?

Sierra (Partnerships): Yes — final list in doc under 'announce-priority'. Current tentative: CloudRange, AtlasHW, IntegrateCo, NorthStar SI, Helix Cloud. Open to swaps before Tue noon.

Jin W: Quick ask — do we treat on-prem HW partners differently for MDF invoicing? Some need invoices to their reseller entity.

Sam (Finance): Yes — invoice rules differ. Jin, cc finance@ for onboarding the vendor billing flow. We'll draft a short vendor billing checklist.

Marta Lopez: Action items I captured: 1) Omar finalize marketplace % + timebox policy (Tue EOD), 2) Jin finalize HW splits + gating rubric (Tue EOD), 3) Sierra finalize announce top5 + SI allocation note (Wed EOD), 4) Sam lock contingency rules + invoice checklist (Wed EOD).

Sierra (Partnerships): Perfect. One more: include a short 'how to redeem MDF' blurb for the partner console (one-liner) so partner success can triage requests.

Omar Patel: :thumbsup: will add redemption blurb.

Jin W: Adding gating rubric now.

Sam (Finance): Will update the budget spreadsheet and flag restricted cells.

Sierra (Partnerships): Thanks team — please add final numbers in the doc and ping me once done. I'll consolidate into the QBR playbook and send for legal review.

Omar Patel: Acknowledged — ping when legal is needed.

partners-bot: Thread pinned to #partnerships — QBR playbook working thread.

Marta Lopez: Thanks all, will follow up on announcement comms checklist tomorrow.

Sierra (Partnerships): Closing notes: we want this to be replicable — capture the final matrix as a template for the next quarter. Also logging decisions in the playbook changelog.

Omar Patel: Will do.

Jin W: Done with my part, left comments in the doc.

Sam (Finance): Done — put finance sign-off placeholder in the spreadsheet.

Sierra (Partnerships): Great work. End of thread.
